title: The Night Of The Exorcism Invites You To Play A Very Dangerous Game
excerpt: The Night Of The Exorcism brings demonic possession, difficult choices and nine possible endings to Xbox, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch.
content:
Some house calls are best avoided, but when a young woman is being tormented by something decidedly unholy, there’s not much room for turning down the invitation.

The Night Of The Exorcism is now available on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PlayStation and Nintendo Switch, with the Xbox version priced at £6.99.

Published by Ratalaika Games and developed by Ludomancer Studio, this choice-driven horror adventure heads back to the Dark Ages, where you’ll be summoned to the remote village of Southshire-Upon-Yail to investigate the mysterious illness affecting Isabella. Unfortunately, diagnosing her condition is going to be rather more complicated than checking her temperature.

At A Glance

  • Game: The Night Of The Exorcism
  • Developer: Ludomancer Studio
  • Publisher: Ratalaika Games
  • Platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, PlayStation, Nintendo Switch
  • Price: £6.99 on Xbox
  • Genre: Choice-Driven Horror Adventure

Seven Demons, Nine Possible Endings

Isabella is possessed by seven different demonic creatures, each with their own personality and methods of manipulation. Your job is to identify which entity you’re dealing with, uncover its weaknesses and find a way to drive it out. Get things wrong, however, and the consequences can be fatal.

Information is your most valuable weapon. Through conversations and careful decisions, you’ll gradually uncover the secrets behind Isabella’s condition, with the opportunity to explore an unusual interpretation of Hell that draws on both Christian and Hebrew traditions.

Faith, Doubt And Temptation

The conversations aren’t simply there to move the story along. Your choices shape the investigation, forcing you to weigh up faith, doubt and the temptation to learn more about the forces you’re attempting to defeat.

With nine possible endings, there are plenty of reasons to return and explore different paths. The hand-drawn artwork and haunting soundscapes also help bring this unsettling Dark Ages setting to life.

Can You Complete The Exorcism?

At £6.99 (Xbox Store), The Night Of The Exorcism offers a dark, decision-heavy horror experience built around uncovering secrets and staying one step ahead of some particularly unpleasant company. With seven demons to identify and nine endings to discover, there’s more than one way for this exorcism to play out.

But, curiosity comes at a price. And when the residents of Hell are involved, that’s probably not a bill you want to receive.
